name: MonotoneOn.convexOn_of_deriv
statement: Set ℝ} (hD : Convex ℝ D) {f : ℝ → ℝ} (hf : ContinuousOn f D) (hf' : DifferentiableOn ℝ f (interior D)) (hf'_mono : MonotoneOn (deriv f) (interior D)) : ConvexOn ℝ D f

name: StrictMonoOn.exists_slope_lt_deriv_aux
statement: ℝ} {f : ℝ → ℝ} (hf : ContinuousOn f (Icc x y)) (hxy : x < y) (hf'_mono : StrictMonoOn (deriv f) (Ioo x y)) (h : ∀ w ∈ Ioo x y, deriv f w ≠ 0) : ∃ a ∈ Ioo x y, (f y - f x) / (y - x) < deriv f a

name: StrictMonoOn.exists_slope_lt_deriv
statement: ℝ} {f : ℝ → ℝ} (hf : ContinuousOn f (Icc x y)) (hxy : x < y) (hf'_mono : StrictMonoOn (deriv f) (Ioo x y)) : ∃ a ∈ Ioo x y, (f y - f x) / (y - x) < deriv f a

have_tree.type: deriv f a * (w - x) < deriv f b * (w - x)

name: StrictMonoOn.exists_deriv_lt_slope_aux
statement: ℝ} {f : ℝ → ℝ} (hf : ContinuousOn f (Icc x y)) (hxy : x < y) (hf'_mono : StrictMonoOn (deriv f) (Ioo x y)) (h : ∀ w ∈ Ioo x y, deriv f w ≠ 0) : ∃ a ∈ Ioo x y, deriv f a < (f y - f x) / (y - x)

name: StrictMonoOn.exists_deriv_lt_slope
statement: ℝ} {f : ℝ → ℝ} (hf : ContinuousOn f (Icc x y)) (hxy : x < y) (hf'_mono : StrictMonoOn (deriv f) (Ioo x y)) : ∃ a ∈ Ioo x y, deriv f a < (f y - f x) / (y - x)

have_tree.type: deriv f a * (y - w) < deriv f b * (y - w)

name: StrictMonoOn.strictConvexOn_of_deriv
statement: Set ℝ} (hD : Convex ℝ D) {f : ℝ → ℝ} (hf : ContinuousOn f D) (hf' : StrictMonoOn (deriv f) (interior D)) : StrictConvexOn ℝ D f

name: StrictAntiOn.strictConcaveOn_of_deriv
statement: Set ℝ} (hD : Convex ℝ D) {f : ℝ → ℝ} (hf : ContinuousOn f D) (h_anti : StrictAntiOn (deriv f) (interior D)) : StrictConcaveOn ℝ D f

have_tree.body: by simpa only [← deriv.neg] using h_anti.neg

name: convexOn_of_hasDerivWithinAt2_nonneg
statement: Set ℝ} (hD : Convex ℝ D) {f f' f'' : ℝ → ℝ} (hf : ContinuousOn f D) (hf' : ∀ x ∈ interior D, HasDerivWithinAt f (f' x) (interior D) x) (hf'' : ∀ x ∈ interior D, HasDerivWithinAt f' (f'' x) (interior D) x) (hf''₀ : ∀ x ∈ interior D, 0 ≤ f'' x) : ConvexOn ℝ D f

name: concaveOn_of_hasDerivWithinAt2_nonpos
statement: Set ℝ} (hD : Convex ℝ D) {f f' f'' : ℝ → ℝ} (hf : ContinuousOn f D) (hf' : ∀ x ∈ interior D, HasDerivWithinAt f (f' x) (interior D) x) (hf'' : ∀ x ∈ interior D, HasDerivWithinAt f' (f'' x) (interior D) x) (hf''₀ : ∀ x ∈ interior D, f'' x ≤ 0) : ConcaveOn ℝ D f

name: hasDerivWithinAt_sInf_slope_of_mem_interior
statement: ConvexOn ℝ S f) (hxs : x ∈ interior S) : HasDerivWithinAt f (sInf (slope f x '' {y ∈ S | x < y})) (Ioi x) x

have_tree.name: h
have_tree.type: Ioo x b ⊆ {y | y ∈ S ∧ x < y}
have_tree.body: fun z hz ↦ ⟨habs ⟨hxab.1.trans hz.1, hz.2⟩, hz.1⟩

have_tree.name: h_Ioo
have_tree.type: Tendsto (slope f x) (𝓝[>] x) (𝓝 (sInf (slope f x '' Ioo x b)))

name: hasDerivWithinAt_sSup_slope_of_mem_interior
statement: ConvexOn ℝ S f) (hxs : x ∈ interior S) : HasDerivWithinAt f (sSup (slope f x '' {y ∈ S | y < x})) (Iio x) x

have_tree.name: h
have_tree.type: Ioo a x ⊆ {y | y ∈ S ∧ y < x}
have_tree.body: fun z hz ↦ ⟨habs ⟨hz.1, hz.2.trans hxab.2⟩, hz.2⟩

have_tree.name: h_Ioo
have_tree.type: Tendsto (slope f x) (𝓝[<] x) (𝓝 (sSup (slope f x '' Ioo a x)))

name: leftDeriv_le_rightDeriv_of_mem_interior
statement: ConvexOn ℝ S f) (hxs : x ∈ interior S) : derivWithin f (Iio x) x ≤ derivWithin f (Ioi x) x

name: lt_slope_of_hasDerivWithinAt_Ioi
statement: StrictConvexOn ℝ S f) (hx : x ∈ S) (hy : y ∈ S) (hxy : x < y) (hf' : HasDerivWithinAt f f' (Ioi x) x) : f' < slope f x y

have_tree.body: hfc.secant_strict_mono hx hu hy hxu.ne' hxy.ne' huy

name: slope_lt_of_hasDerivWithinAt_Iio
statement: StrictConvexOn ℝ S f) (hx : x ∈ S) (hy : y ∈ S) (hxy : x < y) (hf' : HasDerivWithinAt f f' (Iio y) y) : slope f x y < f'

have_tree.body: hfc.secant_strict_mono hy hx hu hxy.ne huy.ne hxu
